 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Welcome to Thursday evening, folks! Hopefully you've had yourself a decent day thus far and are settling in to watch some hockey tonight.
 Of course, the Bruins will be competing for local eyeballs with the New England Patriots, who are facing the Bears in Chicago a little later tonight.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Regardless of which game you choose to watch, you'll be watching bears of some kind, so that's nice.
 The B's had a dominant showing last time they played on home ice, a 5-1 win over the Flyers. Here's to hoping that trend continues after the recent road trip.
 Bruins! Predators! BACK IN MASSACHUSETTS!
